name: Low back — stability
for: A back that is past the sore stage and needs to stay that way
blurb: The stability work behind most back programmes, plus the hinge that teaches bending without the back doing it. Three times a week.
notes: Brace gently — a stiff waist, not a held breath.
Quality over count: stop a set when the form goes.
The hinge pattern is the one to carry into lifting, gardening and getting out of a car.
